raw:
Max Verstappen is the only one of Liam Lawson's teammates who won a championship, and that was in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 (four titles, from my own knowledge rather than the search results).

The searches confirmed that Lawson raced for RB F1 Team in 2024 and 2025, and that Yuki Tsunoda and Isack Hadjar were his teammates in 2025. Neither has won a title. The searches did not directly show Lawson's Red Bull stint alongside Verstappen in 2025, so that link rests on my recollection. Daniel Ricciardo, his 2024 teammate, has never won a title either.

ANSWER: Max Verstappen
